name: keystone-vectorworks
description: Lets Claude draw exact, well-organised 2D plans in your open Vectorworks drawing: no gaps, no overlaps, true arcs, every object in the right class and layer.
long_description:
Keystone for Vectorworks by Seraphin Ernst – exact 2D drawing tools for architects – inside Claude. Claude draws polygons, polylines with true arcs, rectangles, circles, lines, text and dimensions in your open Vectorworks file, reads back what Vectorworks stored (deviation: 0), checks the drawing for overlaps, gaps, near misses, duplicates, double lines and open outlines with a numbered check image, and fixes them exactly. Layers and classes are used properly: new objects get their attributes by class.

Requires Vectorworks 2026 on macOS and the one-time menu command "MCP Run Job" (see the README). The bridge into Vectorworks is installed automatically. Everything stays on this Mac (~/.vwmcp); nothing is sent anywhere else. Based on giorgiomoroder/vectorworks-mcp (MIT).
